objective_difference: This adaptation averages the KL divergence over each source task. The pinned upstream training driver reuses the final source-task KL. Thus official neural classes are reused, but the full outer-loop objective is not bit-for-bit identical.
transfer_failure: The fixed 3-reference, width32, 1000-episode operator-domain experiment exhibits reproducible target-adaptation instability. Independent full-training replay matches the extreme checkpoints. Signed Meta-SGD updates can increase target support loss; the worst A100 cell rises3.5234->4.1772->21.1989, and its worst depthwise-group feature is23.45source standard deviations away. This is not evidence of general inferiority of published HELP.
zero_probe: Zero-probe predictions have no target-measurement dependency. The combined evaluation program also reads target references for its six other output conditions.
